verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Referrals API that automates uploading lists of referrals to block and trust lists, which is a genuine bulk operation over many items. That covers only risk-list entries; no evidence shows bulk actions on cases, disputes, transactions or rules. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond referral list uploads (e.g., batch case review or dispute handling), documented batch limits or semantics, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can use our Referrals API to automate uploading lists of referrals and referral details to block and trust lists.
